ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web marks grizzly bear, red-tailed hawk, chipmunk, marmot, grouse, deer, as well as plant categories berries and flowers, grasses, seeds. The red arrows in the figure indicate food relationships, and near grizzly bear there are arrows from plant material and also arrows from animals. Reasoning: The question asks which species eats both plants and animals. Because grizzly bear is connected to both plant foods and animal foods, this shows that it is a species that eats both plants and animals. Therefore the answer is bear.
